# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_cli_surface.py; do not edit by hand. -->

This reference lists 114 parser nodes including the root and 94 leaves. It is generated from argparse help and describes the parser surface, not a certification of handler behavior.

Tests exercise help, parser-required arguments, and dispatch with handlers replaced by stubs. They do not execute live inference, deployments, endpoint calls, destructive operations, or verify external dependencies. Required markers cover argparse requirements only; handlers may impose additional prerequisites. Consult command help and the relevant runbook before execution; defaults and configuration can affect side effects.

Behavioral checks are maintained separately, including `tests/test_cli_audit_regressions.py`, `tests/test_eval.py`, `tests/test_job_cli.py`, `tests/test_experiments.py`, and the service CLI tests. These offline tests do not establish that live services or credentials are available.

Regenerate with `python scripts/check_cli_surface.py`; verify with `python scripts/check_cli_surface.py --check`.

### `sandbox eval`

**Scope:** May run inference or write results; mock/dry-run options vary.

Primary tasks: `specialist [TARGET]` (all five live-class specialists, or one) and `pipeline [--class CLASS]` (the full connected graph over every class, or one). Other eval tasks still run for existing configs; `sandbox eval --all-tasks` lists them.

**Subcommands:** `specialist`, `pipeline`.

**Also accepted (not primary; hidden from help and menus):** 22 legacy subcommands, listed by `sandbox eval --all-tasks`.

| Argument | Required by parser | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | No | show this help message and exit |

| `--prompt` | No | Local prompt variant stem (e.g. sorter_local_v0) |
| `--agent-model` | No | Surgical per-agent model override (repeatable) |
| `--all-tasks` | No | list every eval task, including the non-primary ones |

### `sandbox eval specialist`

**Scope:** May run inference or write results; mock/dry-run options vary.

Score the live-class specialists in isolation. TARGET: contract, merger_agreement, corporate_record, correspondence, insurance_claim (or the specialist name, e.g. contracts_specialist).

Repeatable, one per role. Texts come from the dojo lineage only; an unknown key, a key/role mismatch or a role the pipeline lacks is an error. Default (no flag) is unchanged. |
| `target` | No | one specialist: contract, merger_agreement, corporate_record, correspondence, insurance_claim |

| `study` | Yes |  |

| `--decision-reviewer` | No | freeze a decision-model reviewer (decisions:openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions with the lineage frontrunner question set, jev:jev-1.13.0, local:MODEL or mock:mock); needs --decision-class |
| `--decision-class` | No | class the decision reviewer handles, with its cutoff in [0, 1] (repeatable) |
| `--specialist-tier` | No | specialists' model: base = the run's model, mid = Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, full = the judge's Qwen3.5-27B (config/models.yaml critical_tier) Choices: base, mid, full. |
| `--design` | No | Choices: single, sand42. |
| `--doc-class` | No | Choices: contract, corporate_record, correspondence, insurance_claim, merger_agreement. |
| `--samples` | No | documents per selected class, shared across every cell |
| `--seed` | No |  |
| `--subclass` | No | restrict the draw to corpus subclass tokens (repeatable) |
| `--dataset` | No |  |
| `--dataset-config` | No |  |
| `--split` | No |  |
| `--revision` | No |  |
| `--local-dataset` | No | local JSONL instead of Hub (also useful for offline mock checks) |
| `--provider` | No | Choices: modal-vllm, openrouter. |
| `--gpu` | No | Modal GPU class, optionally :N for tensor parallel |
| `--no-named-image` | No | build the serving image instead of reusing the published sandbox-vllm:<tag> |
| `--replicas` | No | override cell replica count |
| `--concurrency` | No |  |
| `--max-tokens` | No |  |
| `--temperature` | No |  |
| `--trace-sink` | No | Choices: langfuse, otlp, phoenix, none. |
| `--trace-endpoint` | No |  |
| `--cost-cap-usd` | No | per-run estimated Modal GPU cap; default: recommended from samples, concurrency, GPUs and task |
| `--max-wall-seconds` | No | per-run wall-clock ceiling (the run aborts and its fleet is torn down); default: recommended |
| `--api-cost-cap-usd` | No | per-run API token spend cap for OpenRouter agents; default: recommended from token prices |
| `--smoke-rows` | No |  |
| `--smoke-cost-cap-usd` | No |  |
